system.description:
You focus Lightning chakra into a super compressed point on the tip of your finger, pointing it at a creature you can see in range, and releasing it in a single swift motion. The lightning explodes leaving your finger with an audible explosive boom, that shatters glass and other fragile but rigid material in a 500-foot radius. Make a ranged ninjutsu attack. On a hit, the target creature takes 9d12 Lightning damage.

Overcharge. If you target a creature within 5 feet of you and make the ranged attack at disadvantage, increase your critical threat range by +3. If you score a critical hit, triple the damage die, instead of doubling it.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and increase the damage by 2d12.
